summary: The --ortho/--flat renderer options work and the test fixture is safe (wx blocks planted files and symlinks; cleanup removes only the owned file). But the asset name is never validated: a dot-dot name escapes assets/ and out/, and the new flat pass recursively deletes a pre-existing directory at the escaped path. That blocks the phase.
blocking_findings: F1 [Blocker] review-b: Path traversal through the asset name reaches the new --flat recursive delete. src/pipeline.ts:28-34 (assetPath) validates only file existence, so `./forge render ../measure/runs/chibi_sprouts_redesign_20261123/probe-escape --fast --bg none --flat --views front-level --size 64` built and rendered an asset from outside assets/ and wrote stats.json, the GLB, and flat/front-level.png entirely outside out/ (end-to-end probe through heavy-run.sh). The new T3 code `rmSync(join(out, 'flat'), { recursive: true, force: true })` in the flat branch of src/cli/forge.ts recursively deleted a pre-existing marker.txt at the escaped path before writing the views. Writes outside out/ predate this diff (glb/stats/textures follow the same out variable), but the flat pass adds a recursive-delete primitive to the traversal, and the audit invariant 'writes stay under out/<name>/flat/' does not hold. Fix: reject asset names that contain a path separator or a dot-dot segment before assetPath and outName are computed (for example /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$/ over the raw name).
nonblocking_findings: F2 [Nit] review-b: tests/render-options.test.ts removes the fixture asset in afterAll but leaves out/_flat-render-pin-<pid>/ (flat PNGs, stats.json, GLB) behind, and a crash before afterAll leaves the fixture itself in assets/. Both leftovers are inert (the `_` prefix keeps the asset out of listAssets, and a stale file fails a later run closed with 'fixture path exists'), but the test should remove its out/ directory together with the fixture.

F3 [Nit] review-b: `--size` accepts any finite number through num() (src/cli/forge.ts:774-778), so `--size 1e9` reaches the canvas allocation in src/render/page.ts. This predates the diff and the run fails on allocation, but a sanity cap (for example 1..8192) would fail fast with a clear message.
evidence: HEAD matches audited_head_sha 2a33c7c1; phase_base_sha 23e551df is its ancestor; role_base_sha recorded as HEAD.

Traversal probe (wrapped render, exit 0): a dot-dot asset name was accepted end to end; stats.json and flat/front-level.png landed in measure/runs/chibi_sprouts_redesign_20261123/probe-escape/ (outside out/), the GLB landed in a doubled-traversal path, and the pre-existing marker.txt inside the escaped flat/ directory was deleted by rmSync recursive before the views were written.
Static confirmation: join(ASSET_DIR, name + '.ts') and join(OUT_DIR, outName) normalize the dot-dot segments; assetPath checks existsSync only and has no separator or dot-dot rejection.

wx probe: writeFileSync with flag 'wx' against a planted symlink failed with EEXIST, the symlink target kept its content, and the symlink itself survived, so the test fixture cannot overwrite or follow a planted file or symlink at assets/_flat-render-pin-<pid>.ts.

Fixture cleanup audit: removeOwned() rmSyncs only FIXTURE_PATH and only when created=true, and the wx create sets created only after a successful exclusive create, so cleanup cannot delete a user file.
View names are validated against NAMED_VIEWS (src/cli/forge.ts:743-746) and the az/el custom name is built from numbers, so the flat write loop's file names cannot traverse.
Preset traversal is blocked: renderViews calls applyPreset before any write and throws for a name not in variants.presets (src/render/page.ts:207-213,416).
The diff adds no process.env reads, no fetch/network calls, and no eval; asset loading is the pre-existing ssrLoadModule of a path that passed the existence check.
useFlatMaterials swaps materials and restores them plus the ground in a finally block (src/render/page.ts:49-74, 430-463), so a failed render leaves the page state intact.
A2 not applicable: no draft-to-published status flip exists in this track's surface.

A6: measure/tracks.md claims no resolved security state for this track; the scanner pin refresh binds the real lines 331, 531, and 538 of src/render/page.ts (verified by sed), matching review-a's wrapped green run of tests/apk3d/no-unpolyfilled-builtins.test.ts.
No secret or home path appears in render outputs: stats.json holds name/bounds/triangle counts; console output prints cwd-relative paths.

All probes ran through heavy-run.sh with HEAVY_MIN_AVAIL_MB=1500; every probe artifact was removed; the only running heavy jobs belong to review-a (REVIEW_P4_OWNER=review-a-0849215); nothing of this review is left running.
